stages.name: Check conventions
stages.instruction: Check the principal-log branch conventions for one physical positive s approached from above and for negative t and u. Use a short Python calculation and print only the three logarithm values. Do not derive or submit the amplitude.

stages.name: Check one channel
stages.instruction: Work out the one-loop bubble contribution in the s channel from the stated Feynman rules. Use a short Python calculation to check its logarithm branch and imaginary part in the physical region. Print only the coefficient and check result. Do not assemble or submit the full amplitude.

stages.name: Assemble and submit
stages.instruction: Using the convention and one-channel results in this conversation, assemble the crossing-symmetric renormalized amplitude. Submit a complete Python implementation in one `submit` block. Keep the response focused on the code.
